title: Belgian Workers Find $10 Million in Gold Coins and Bars
summary: Construction workers in Belgium discovered approximately $10 million worth of gold coins and bars at a work site. The discovery has left police surprised, and the ownership of the treasure is currently undetermined. The find was reported by Navbharat Times, which noted the workers were from India.
summary_points: Construction workers in Belgium found gold coins and bars valued at $10 million.
The discovery was made at a work site.
Police expressed surprise at the find.
The ownership of the gold is currently unknown.
Navbharat Times reported the workers were from India.

summary_hi: बेल्जियम में निर्माण श्रमिकों को एक कार्यस्थल पर लगभग 10 मिलियन डॉलर मूल्य के सोने के सिक्के और बार मिले। इस खोज ने पुलिस को हैरान कर दिया है, और खजाने के मालिक का पता फिलहाल नहीं चला है। नवभारत टाइम्स ने इस खबर को रिपोर्ट किया, जिसमें बताया गया कि मजदूर भारत से थे।
